content: GITHUB PUBLICATION APPROACH REVISED 2026-05-19: Anthony surfaced a better repo structure than the per-paper approach I had initially drafted. The new structure is a SINGLE UMBRELLA COMPANION REPO (gap6-companion) that mirrors the Gap 6 papers cited prior works in one place, with provenance trail, methodology documentation, and a related-work map showing the three axes of the research program (cannabinoid pharmacology / VDAC1 decision gate / methodology) and how the cited pieces connect. Standalone canonical repos (cbd-two-pathway-model, iris-gate) are PRESERVED at their existing URLs and the companion archive links back to them as authoritative. The mirrors in the companion archive exist for reader convenience; external citers resolve to DOIs and canonical repos. WHY THE NEW APPROACH IS BETTER: optimizes for the Gap 6 papers reader experience rather than individual paper visibility. A reviewer clicks one link from the reference list and lands on a curated archive showing the integrated research program. They get the coherent context in one click instead of chasing six separate URLs. The map is doing real credibility work that the paper itself does not have to make: shows the program is integrated rather than scattered. Time savings: 90 minutes to 2 hours total versus 2-3 hours for the per-paper approach because only one push to execute. METHODOLOGY OBSERVATION: I defaulted to one-per-paper structure based on field conventions without asking what the repo should DO. Anthony asked what it should do and got a better answer by reframing the question. This is the same kind of move Anthony makes throughout the work -- ask what the artifact should accomplish, not what is conventional. Worth chronicling as a pattern: when designing artifacts, the question is what does the reader need, not what does the field expect. INSTRUCTION SET AT /mnt/user-data/outputs/HQ_companion_repo_instructions.md (eleven phases, 2681 words). The prior instruction set at HQ_github_instructions.md is now SUPERSEDED by this one; HQ should execute this one. Pending: HQ execution of the eleven phases. Estimated time 90 minutes to 2 hours focused session. The Gap 6 paper v2 at Gap6_paper_v2.md remains submission-ready and the companion repo provides the public landing infrastructure for its citations. Sequencing: companion repo lands first, then Gap 6 preprint posts referencing the live companion archive URL.
